_note: youtubeId and publishedAt are REAL — read from each video's own public YouTube page (oEmbed + watch-page metadata), not invented. Each title is built from that video's actual YouTube title, expanded with its year and a short descriptor for context; the English/Arabic counterpart of whichever language the original was in is a translation. publishedAt drives both the 'Newest' sort and the 'New' badge; it is optional, and an item without it is never badged and sorts to the end under Newest. Duration and video quality are deliberately NOT stored here: a YouTube <iframe> is cross-origin, so neither can be read back from the embed at runtime, and anything kept here would be hand-maintained and silently drift. 'featured: true' is an editorial pick: it is what puts a video in the Featured carousel above the library grid. It is NOT a sort option and NOT a badge — featured videos also stay in the grid below, unmarked. Omit the field entirely for normal videos. There is no 'badge' field either: the only card badge is 'New', worked out at render time from publishedAt (see getVideoBadge in script.js) so that it expires on its own.
